name: blast-charge-loading-ui
description: Visual verification of charge loading UI: per-hole charges, explosive types, amounts, charge-all, visual indicators

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:5 depth:6 start:15,15
steps.description: Two increment clicks on the spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") raise it 3->5m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts) before dragging, so the (15,15)-(25,25) rectangle computes the declared 3x3 instead of the default-spacing 4x4 (issue #479 follow-up, Finding #4).

charge hole:H1 explosive:boomite amount:3 stemming:2 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

charge hole:H2 explosive:boomite amount:8 stemming:2 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

charge hole:H3 explosive:boomite amount:5 stemming:1 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).

expect.note: Charge All applies uniformly to every hole, overwriting the 3 individual per-hole charges set above — the H5 override below then re-charges just that one hole again after this

steps.description: charge hole:H5 explosive:boomite amount:7 stemming:3 — no per-hole charging in the UI by design (Charge.ts's own header: "per-hole charging isn't a feature here anyway"); only Charge All exists. Left as a command (Finding #10).
